integrity: The proof is reconstructed from an explicit annular localization. After scaling frequency by R, the normalized phase converges in smooth topology to log|eta|, whose Hessian is fully nondegenerate. A uniform stationary-phase estimate bounds the norm of a phase-canceling test function, while multiplication by the model symbol produces a fixed output. Dilation and duality then give the global necessary condition. The current source version and its Lorentz endpoint statement were checked directly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a necessary condition and a quantitative localized lower bound for the specific radial logarithmic model. It does not settle strong Lp boundedness at the critical equality and does not claim necessity for every symbol in the broader localized logarithmic Miyachi class.
title: Sharp below-endpoint decay threshold for logarithmic oscillatory multipliers
